claims.statement: elfhub is built with hatchling and the wheel packages only src/elfhub; the package declares no runtime dependencies and requires Python >= 3.9.
Dev tooling (pytest, build, twine) is isolated in the optional `dev` extra and installed only in CI, not as runtime dependencies.

CI's test job runs a Python 3.9-13 matrix and its publish job runs only on `v*` tags after the test job succeeds, building with `python -m build` and publishing via trusted Publishing (gh-action-pypi-publish, id-token: write).
Releases are cut by pushing a `v*` tag; the workflow has no step syncing the tagged version with the pyproject version, so a version bump must be committed before tagging.
The CI test step runs `python demo/demo.py`, which creates its own venv and exercises the published PyPI package, having replaced the earlier pytest suite under `tests/`.
